name: 18-heal-after-the-gym
objective: Out of the gym with the badge, back across Pewter City to the Pokemon Center, and heal what Brock cost before going on.
evidence: party_missing_hp=0 AND map=0x3A - the party is whole and standing inside Pewter's Pokemon Center. See the 16-heal-in-pewter evidence for what party_missing_hp reads.

A REPEAT HEAL AT THE SAME POKEMON CENTER LEAVES NO CARTRIDGE-VISIBLE TRACE, and this goal is the strongest claim available rather than a proof. wLastBlackoutMap is already $02 from link 16, so the flip that proves the first Pewter heal cannot prove a second one. 'Whole, and inside the building' forces anyone who is hurt through the nurse and cannot be satisfied by walking past the door, but it does not distinguish a party that healed from one that arrived whole. That is a limit of the cartridge, not of the harness.
require badges>=1 - a run that reached this link without the badge is judged a forfeit rather than allowed to heal its way to a pass.
